description: This file defines the ChangelogService class which manages changelog data, including fetching, version mapping, and listener management within a software project.

classes.name: ChangelogService
classes.description: A service class that handles fetching, processing, and notifying about changelog updates.

methods.name: addLastReadChangeListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for last read changelog version updates.

methods.name: performDownloadChangelog
methods.description: Fetches and parses the changelog JSON from a remote URL.

methods.name: getChangelog
methods.description: Retrieves the changelog, downloading if necessary, and applies version mapping based on environment.

methods.name: markAsRead
methods.description: Marks the current changelog version as read and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getLastReadVersion
methods.description: Returns the last read changelog version from storage.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of changelog versions.

methods.name: getLegacyMapping
methods.description: Provides version mapping based on environment (Desktop or Mobile).

methods.name: getDesktopDownloadsUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for desktop downloads for a specific version.

methods.name: getDesktopVersionForWebVersion
methods.description: Maps a web version to a desktop version if available.
